cycle_checks.tested: Diagonal rephasing preserves each oriented cycle product. Traces of powers count closed cycles with their accumulated weight. Random phases have a fixed seed.

state_preparation_checks.tested: Apply signed eliminations on increasingly ordered adjacent pairs, gather at the positive basis input and reverse to the exact target. Negative single-site targets use one sign-flip gate. The general lower bound is proved in the packet.

scope: Finite auxiliary diagnostics for public mechanisms. Correctness, necessity and tightness are assessed in the question-first proofs.
